name: decision-router
description: Picks the Claude model for each turn: a decision model (Clef or Jev) describes the task, and a policy tuned for subscription limits chooses Haiku, Sonnet, Opus or Fable.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: watch shows the pick and changes nothing; route switches the model; off does nothing. /router changes it at any time.

backend.title: Decision model
backend.description: clef-workers: Clef Flash on Cloudflare Workers AI. jev-api: Jev on TypeSafe's API (Jev runs only there). local: a System One server you run, such as Unsloth or Clef on SGLang. llamacpp: llama.cpp's llama-server running a decision model such as Clef or Laya.

preference.title: Preference
preference.description: cost leans toward cheaper models and saves plan usage; quality leans toward stronger ones.

allow_fable.title: Allow Fable
allow_fable.description: Let very hard, non-security tasks run on Fable 5.1. Fable may bill to usage credits rather than your plan.

min_confidence.title: Minimum confidence
min_confidence.description: Below this confidence in the decision model's difficulty answer (0 flat, 1 certain, computed the same way for every backend), the current model is kept.

cloudflare_api_token.title: Cloudflare API token
cloudflare_api_token.description: Workers AI token for clef-workers. Scope it to Workers AI only. To clear a saved key, enter none.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: For jev-api. To clear a saved key, enter none.

local_url.title: Local server URL
local_url.description: Address of the server for local or llamacpp. Empty uses http://127.0.0.1:8888/v1/systemone for local (Unsloth) and http://127.0.0.1:9931 for llamacpp. For llamacpp, the host and port are enough, for example http://10.0.0.9:9931.

local_api_key.title: Local server API key
local_api_key.description: Bearer key for local or llamacpp, such as an Unsloth sk-unsloth- token or llama-server's --api-key. Leave empty for a keyless server. To clear a saved key, enter none.

decision_model.title: Decision model ID
decision_model.description: The model to ask. Empty uses each backend's default: clef-flash on Workers AI, jev-latest on TypeSafe, default on a local server (Unsloth's selected model), and none for llamacpp (a single-model llama-server needs no name). For Clef on SGLang, use Cloudflare/clef-flash.

timeout_ms.title: Decision model timeout (ms)
timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for the decision model before keeping the current model. 0 picks it for you: 2500 for hosted backends, 8000 for local.
